title: Held-out examples are used only in review
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Judgment is replaced by review.
decision: A held-out example is given only to the reviewers of a story whose risk warranted it, never during the build. When it fails it becomes visible, and the illustrator writes a cold replacement for the next review.
consequences: The held-out example concept states this.
